purpose: Standalone ClearExams Group I 2015 source-numbered English adapted PYQ study quiz. Not certified verbatim bilingual paper; original TNPSC source PDF linked. Only source-audited final-key-matched positions graded.

questions.text:

finalKeyVersionCrosswalk.proof: The official 2015 TNPSC final answer PDF lists the exact GS0811 question code and omega booklet symbol, matching the visually reviewed paper.

papers.sourceAudit:
16 Nov 2026 official TNPSC bilingual original GS0811 ω PDF pages 2–15 individually inspected for original positions Q1–Q32. Q8–Q32 added in English editorial adaptation with four printed A–D options in original order. Independent authenticated 08 Nov 2015 GS0811 ω final answer key mapped; Q20 explicitly A OR C. Q21 mismatches historical Bardoli 1928 with printed 1929; Q22 incorrectly assigns Shuja-ud-Daula to Bengal rather than Awadh; Q26 marks Gandhi but Bardoli residents conferred title 'Sardar'. These three are attendable study questions but ungraded. 29 of 32 typed positions are eligible for study scores; 168 original positions remain untyped. On 17 Nov 2026, Q33–Q50 were added as original-numbered *editorially rephrased* aptitude study items from cross-checked Radian IAS bilingual 2015 secondary facsimile and CivilServiceAspirants indexed 2015 Q31–50.
